sources.name: Moxie review after six months of use
Freelance client management discussion on Reddit

claims.statement: The product lineage launched as Hectic FreelancerOS on June 21, 2022, before adopting the Moxie name.
Moxie combines client records, sales leads, proposals, contracts, invoices, payment tools, time tracking, scheduling, calendars, forms, projects, and basic accounting.
Starter costs $12 monthly or $10 per month billed yearly. Pro costs $25 monthly or $20 per month billed yearly. Teams costs $40 monthly or $385 yearly and includes up to five team members.
Moxie offers a 14-day trial. Pro adds a white-labeled client portal, workflow automation, phone line, API connections, QuickBooks, and unlimited project collaborators.
Replacing several separate freelancer tools with one client-to-invoice workflow is the strongest positive theme.
Freelancers commonly describe the basic workflow as intuitive and time-saving, with frequent praise for support and product updates.
Project planning is lighter than a dedicated project tool, while navigation, mobile polish, advanced sales tracking, packages, and automation have narrower complaints.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The broad workflow can remove setup across several apps, but templates, payment rules, contracts, taxes, and client access need a full dry run.
scoreRationale.product: Strong for a solo service business moving a client from inquiry to invoice; lighter for complex project and agency planning.
scoreRationale.support: Support receives repeated praise, though Digital Macaroni did not test a deadline-sensitive request.
scoreRationale.billing: Starter is inexpensive for the breadth. Pro is likely the practical plan when the client portal, automation, API, or collaborators matter.
scoreRationale.overall: Moxie is worth testing when it can replace several small tools. Run one client through the entire job and count every spreadsheet, manual copy, and outside app that remains.

conflictsAndUnknowns: The strongest ratings come from a solicited Trustpilot sample and discounted lifetime-deal buyers.
Broad feature coverage is the main strength and also the reason some areas are lighter than dedicated tools.
A solo workflow can be simple while team capacity and project dependencies still fall short.
No hands-on client, contract, payment, mobile, export, cancellation, or support test was completed.
